newsitem.title: USA: Steel Partners says supports merger of unit.
newsitem.headline: Steel Partners says supports merger of unit.

text.p: Steel Partners II LP said Friday it agreed to support a proposed merger of Medical Imaging Centers of America Inc and a wholly owned subsidiary of US Diagnostics Inc.
Steel Partners and its affiliates owns 19.6 percent of Medical Imaging Center's outstanding common stock. The merger is the subject of a special shareholders meeting scheduled for November 6.

Warren Lichtenstein, a managing member of Steel Partners, said in a statement that the company initially sought board representation, but decided to back off, "notwithstanding a positive shareholder vote, to afford management a fair opportunity to sell the company at true value."
